questions.question: Which correction fixes: "Did llm proxy service crashed?"
options: A. Did the llm proxy service crash?
B. Did llm proxy service crashed?
C. Does the llm proxy service crashed?
D. Did the llm proxy service crashed?
questions.explanation: After "Did," use the base verb "crash," not the past tense "crashed." Add the article "the" before the service name.

questions.question: Which correction fixes: "Are the logs cleared when the servcie restart?"
options: A. Are the logs cleared when the service restarts?
B. Are the logs cleared when the servcie restart?
C. Is the logs cleared when the service restarts?
D. Are the logs cleared when the service restart?
questions.explanation: Fix the typo "servcie" → "service," and use third-person singular "restarts" because "service" is singular.

questions.question: Which is the most natural way to ask whether a port is reachable?
options: A. Is port 8765 open?
B. is the port 8765 opened.
C. Is the port 8765 opened?
D. Does port 8765 opened?
questions.explanation: Use "open" (not "opened") for port availability, capitalize the sentence, and end with a question mark.

questions.question: In today's log, what problem occurred after reinstalling OMX?
options: A. All hooks were registered twice
B. The llm proxy port changed to 9091
C. Prompt caching was disabled in llm-bench
D. The board firmware failed to flash over SPI
questions.explanation: The log notes that after reinstalling OMX, every hook was registered twice, causing a messy hook setup.

questions.question: What does "refactor session tests in llm-bench to support prompt caching" refer to?
options: A. Updating benchmark tests so repeated prompts can reuse cached prefill data
B. Removing all session tests from the llm-bench suite
C. Converting llm-bench from Rust to Python
D. Disabling the RK1828 NPU during benchmark runs
questions.explanation: Prompt caching stores precomputed key/value states for a prefix so later requests with the same prefix run faster.

questions.question: Which correction fixes: "Opton 3"
options: A. Option 3
B. Opton 3
C. Option three
D. Options 3
questions.explanation: The word is spelled "option," and when referring to a numbered choice in a list, capitalize it as "Option 3."

questions.question: Translate into natural English: "我想在1828上加是prompt的prefill的cache,可以自己加吗"
questions.modelAnswer: Can I add a prompt prefill cache on the 1828 board myself?
questions.explanation: This [ZH] line asks whether prompt prefill caching can be added manually on the RK1828 hardware.

questions.question: Translate into natural English: "首先是他为什么推理一次就死了?"
questions.modelAnswer: First of all, why does it die after just one inference?
questions.explanation: The speaker is debugging a service that crashes immediately after a single inference run on the board.

questions.question: Translate into natural English: "你写个方案把, 后续如何验证, 正式方案要怎么设计"
questions.modelAnswer: Write a plan covering how we will verify it going forward and how the production solution should be designed.
questions.explanation: This [ZH] request asks for a written plan with validation steps and a formal architecture design.

questions.question: Rewrite as a clear technical instruction: "That must be the reason. fix it"
questions.modelAnswer: That must be the reason. Fix it.
questions.explanation: Capitalize the start of the second sentence and use a period or em dash to separate the diagnosis from the action.
